title: Test the fix
lesson: Evaluate an agent-generated fix against both the requested behavior and existing behavior before advancing it to human review.
limitations: Illustrative authentication patches and two checks; no agent experiment or comprehensive security evaluation.
Patch A to B depicts revision, not repeated trials of one configuration.
Passing checks supports human review, not release authorization or permission enforcement.
Audio was measured and inspected spectrally, not physically listened to.
Self-reviewed; no comparative recommendation across variants.

transcript.text: Illustration: a coding agent proposes authentication patch A. It rejects an empty password, so the new requirement passes.
The same patch also rejects a valid password. The existing login behavior fails even though the new test passed.
Both results reach the evaluation gate. One required check failed, so the candidate is blocked.
The agent produces revised patch B. Previous results clear. Fresh checks now reject the empty password and accept the valid password; both pass.
The two passing checks advance patch B to human review. This limited example does not establish release readiness. The scene fades for a clean loop.
